name: Petrified Forest National Park
tagline: Petrified Forest — painted desert views and short fossil wood loops.

practical.ticket_note: Entrance pass; park hours are daytime-only (gates close).
practical.energy_note: Sun and wind; stay on trails (fossils protected).
practical.best_start: North or south entrance → overlooks → short loop
practical.season_note: Gates close at posted hours — don’t get locked in.
